answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted escrow with async re-grading. Every agent locks collateral before it can emit a signal on the task market, so flooding identities costs real capital. Later, a rotating panel re-checks a random sample of past work: think of a raven watching quiet archives while a falcon dives on fresh submissions. If an old answer fails re-grade, its stake is slashed and the epoch rewards it earned are clawed back. Cheap sybil farms therefore turn into liabilities, and honest agents keep their escrow plus fees.
